newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai stocks jump at open on continued buys.
newsitem.headline: Thai stocks jump at open on continued buys.

text.p: Thai stocks rose sharply by 7.1 percent at the open on Thursday on continued foreign buying of key stocks across the board, brokers said.
The composite SET index advanced 40.38 points to 609.17 on brisk 486 million baht turnover at the open.

The buying came as investors reacted positively to the government's announcement on Wednesday that the Thai exchange rate system was being changed from a pegged system to a managed float, effective immediately.
Brokers reacted positively to what they said was a de-facto devaluation of the baht.

"Foreigners bought all the key stocks when the market opened. The ongoing buying is carried over from yesterday as they couldn't buy yesterday because those key stocks hit their (10 percent) limit up," said Thanadech Mahapokai of Book Club Finance and Securities.
